scope: Frozen black-box tests listed in testcase-lock.json only
reason: The owner required Simple Harness to use the extracted SDK, remove the old same-source Kernel and Workflows, and keep agent.general as the sole semantic selector.

allowed_changes.old: Imports of SDK-owned symbols from backend.deskpet.harness, backend.deskpet.execution, backend.deskpet.workflows, backend.agent.agent_loop, and backend.providers.openai_compatible
allowed_changes.new: Imports of the matching public simple_harness symbols, or consumer Adapter factories that implement a simple_harness public Port
allowed_changes.constraint: Existing terminal status, event, identity, idempotency, effect, delivery, authorization, budget, and recovery assertions must retain the same normalized assertion AST hash

allowed_changes.old: Fixtures that directly construct RunKernel with RegisteredRouter/StaticClassifier or launch ticketless children
allowed_changes.new: Fixtures construct the fixed agent.general SDK runtime and issue a frozen one-shot ProfileLaunchTicket for children
allowed_changes.constraint: Tests that assert canonical durable behavior are migrated; assertions that require the retired bypass itself are removed and recorded in the transformation receipt

allowed_changes.old: Personal Workflow fixtures whose only semantic authority is ModelPersonalWorkflowMatcher returning one preselected candidate
allowed_changes.new: Fixtures expose a bounded PersonalWorkflowDescriptor catalog and make agent.general emit workflow_spawn(candidate_id, catalog_generation)
allowed_changes.constraint: Frozen graph/owner/version anti-forgery and safe-tool assertions must be retained or strengthened

forbidden_changes: Changing expected failure to success or success to failure except for explicit removal of legacy router, ticketless child, or independent Personal matcher behavior
Weakening exact-once, unknown, fence, atomicity, authorization, budget, secret-redaction, output-contract, or delivery assertions
Deleting a frozen testcase merely because the new implementation fails it
Adding a compatibility implementation that preserves a second execution authority

verification.mechanism: verify_sdk_oracles.py compares original file hash, approved import/fixture transforms, normalized assertion AST hash, and an explicit retired-assertion receipt
